lines.text: Where have you been since last Thursday?
What on earth do you do there?
When one is in town one amuses oneself. When one is in the country one amuses other people.

source.text: Oscar Wilde, The Importance of Being Earnest (1895), Act I, Algernon and Jack. Public domain (Wilde died 1900). Stage directions dropped, lines contiguous.
source.board: Callboard plan 2026-11-04: format scene, series scene-reads, look cinema. The partner reads Algernon (PARTNER, voiced), you read Jack (YOU, the underlined cue, silent).
source.why: First film built on the new scene beat: the partner's lines light up as they are read, your line is the cue. Earnest (Algernon) is one of the pages Google sends actors to most (CONTEXT.md).
source.voice_note: ElevenLabs refused ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on 2026-11-04 (a key ID, not an sk_ secret), so the partner lines are not voiced in this render; they light up on estimated timing.
